name: Daichi Haruka
source:
Seiran Academy, English teacher

An "older brother" type teacher. He's Shuntaro's homeroom teacher. New and inexperienced, this is the first time he's been in charge of a homeroom class. From the spring he will return to Hokkaido to look after his aging parents.

[From [url=http://www.joinac.com/GAS/graduation/English/chara/index.html]official site[/url]]
